get.description:
Operator diagnostics for automatic web image search (plan Phase 8).

Read-only: reports the rollout gate and SearXNG configuration, and
optionally (``?probe=true``) performs one fixed benign image search —
search only, never an import — so operators can verify the instance
and its image engines without mutating any presentation or asset.

Always answers 200: this is a diagnostics surface, not a liveness
gate; failures appear inside the ``probe`` block instead.

post.description:
Export a presentation that already exists.

Until now export could only happen as a side effect of the endpoint that
created a presentation (`/generate`, `/edit`, `/derive`). If that request
was interrupted — a reverse proxy closing a long-running connection, a
client disconnect, a browser tab closing — the presentation itself was
still generated and stored, but the exported file could no longer be
reached through the API at all. The work was done and paid for, and the
only way back to it was generating the whole thing again.

This exposes the same `export_presentation` helper those endpoints already
call, keyed on an existing presentation id, so an interrupted export can be
retried without regenerating. It also makes the self-hosted v1 API
consistent with the hosted v3 API, which offers `POST /presentation/export`.

post.description:
Rewrite a raw user prompt into a presentation-generation brief.

Validation is fully handled by the request model (FastAPI returns a
standard ``422`` for invalid payloads) and provider failures propagate as
the coded ``CodedHTTPException``/``HTTPException`` raised by the LLM layer.
The endpoint is read-only: it never writes to the database.

Optional ``file_paths`` name the user's decomposed document texts. They
are resolved through the owner-scoped temp-file service before the rewrite
call, so missing, out-of-root, or cross-owner paths fail fast with a
coded 4xx instead of surfacing mid-rewrite; the resolved paths then ground
the rewrite in the cached document profile.
